personas.ai_literacy_level: Medium: Basic understanding of generative AI tools and some familiarity with common indicators of AI-generated content. Can occasionally identify synthetic patterns but may miss subtle cues.
personas.prior_ai_use: Rare: Very limited use of AI systems, usually for experimentation or occasional curiosity.
personas.online_content_skepticism: Moderate: Sometimes questions the reliability or authenticity of online content, especially when inconsistencies or unusual details are noticeable.
personas.attention_to_detail: Medium: Pays attention to noticeable details but may not consistently inspect all aspects of the content carefully.
personas.prior_exposure_to_misinformation: High: Extensive prior exposure to misinformation, manipulated media, online scams, or educational discussions about deceptive digital content.
